symptom: The H3-Max capability source pointed at an obsolete API-reference URL that now returns 404, so the catalog's evidence pointer could not be opened to review the active video contract.
direct_cause: The capability source URL was not refreshed when MiniMax moved the video contract to the current guide route.
class_root: Capability source metadata had no source-reachability regression test, allowing an old vendor documentation path to remain attached to a production model profile.
affected_population: Consumers reviewing the MiniMax H3-Max video profile and its documented 5–15 second, 480P/768P contract.
Future vendor profiles whose source links are moved without updating the single capability source declaration.

external_sources.purpose: Current official MiniMax video guide for H3-Max endpoint, text/first-last/reference modes, and parameter contract.
Negative check: the former source path returns 404 and is not retained as an evidence pointer.

invariants: H3-Max has one current official source pointer that is reachable and dated with the audit.
The source pointer covers the same endpoint and modes represented by the capability profile.
The stale 404 source is not retained as a fallback evidence path.
generality_proof: The source pointer is declared once in MINIMAX_H3_MAX_ARCHETYPE and the contract test reads that owner directly; future source updates have one place and one regression assertion.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Single source-of-truth evidence pointer for the H3-Max capability contract.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: The declaration now uses the reachable official video guide and records checkedAt 2026-09-02.
The test pins the current URL and audit date; no obsolete fallback is accepted.

recurrence.reason: Vendor documentation routes can move or be retired; stale source pointers can recur across model profiles unless the source owner is tested.
same_class_scan: Checked the current MiniMax video and speech official routes and searched the non-KIE/non-APIMart capability sources for adjacent MiniMax URLs.
Confirmed only H3-Max used the retired video-generation-v2 source in the changed scope.

prevention.invariant: The H3-Max source URL and checked date are declared once and pinned by a focused contract test.
prevention.failure_mode: A moved or deleted official page leaves the catalog claiming source-backed evidence that users and maintainers cannot open.
prevention.strategy: Replace the retired URL at the source owner and pin the active URL in the adjacent contract test; do not keep a dead fallback.

legacy_paths.rationale: The obsolete 404 evidence pointer is removed from the profile with no fallback.
legacy_paths.removal_evidence: The profile source assertion accepts only the current guide URL.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No package dependency is changed; only an official documentation evidence pointer is corrected.

migration: No persisted data migration is required; model identity and wire mapping are unchanged.
residual_risks: A reachable official guide does not by itself prove account eligibility or successful paid generation; those are recorded separately in the acceptance ledger.
